Summary: (1) the two mechanisms CANNOT coexist without recurrence -- rte6_package_deploy.py has no path to write a pin back, so every direct-deploy edit to _authz/* silently stales every declared pin; recommend the declarative mechanism as the ONLY one reaching a served Lambda, with any surviving direct-resolve path made pin-writing. (3) irpt-holdings never reaches FWD-5 through this cell's remedy: its enforce.py is not manifest-declared at all, so a manifest re-pin cannot reach it; W1-S29's pre-fix text (checked, unchanged) and the missing unprojected_grant disclosure both persist; the CTO's fold-vs-fix ruling is the only path to FWD-5 for this function.
